questions.subject: MACROECONOMICS
questions.learningObjective: Compute nominal rate for a target real return
questions.stem: A lender wants a 3 percent real return with 4 percent expected inflation; what nominal rate is needed?
questions.explanation: Nominal rate is real plus inflation, 3 plus 4 equals 7 percent; the Fisher equation adds them.

questions.subject: MACROECONOMICS
questions.learningObjective: Predict real rate under deflation
questions.stem: Nominal rate is 2 percent and inflation is negative 3 percent; what is the real rate?
questions.explanation: Real rate is nominal minus inflation, 2 minus negative 3 equals 5 percent; deflation raises the real return.

questions.subject: MACROECONOMICS
questions.learningObjective: Summarize demand-pull inflation
questions.stem: Stage one: aggregate demand exceeds productive capacity; stage two: the result is?

options.text: Deflation, as capacity constraints lower output
Cost-push inflation, as costs must have risen
Demand-pull inflation, as excess demand raises prices
No inflation, because supply adjusts instantly

questions.explanation: Excess demand against limited capacity is the defining condition of demand-pull inflation.
